decisive_items: expansile, heterogeneous (mixed-density) mass occupying the entire left maxillary sinus
deviation and destruction of the nasal septum, invaded the ethmoid sinus
response.rationale: R2 is the most likely diagnosis due to the presence of a large, expansile, heterogeneous mass in the maxillary sinus with invasion into surrounding structures, which is consistent with juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma. R4, fibrous dysplasia, is a possible alternative, but the clinical presentation and imaging findings are more consistent with R2.

rejected.why: lack of bilateral involvement and family history
limited support from clinical presentation and imaging findings
